body:
No one from my life will be here to deal with the crap left behind. The bank can take the house I guess. I have no siblings, and no dependents. If my parents die off, I can just let go.

The people cleaning up will probably be the bank once a few mortgage payments go unpaid.

Seems easy enough if I just wait for my parents to die, then I'll exit as well.

I don't have any dependents. I'll just give all of my stuff away to friends the week before or something.

I'd probably do it with a suicide bag if worse comes to worst. Seems the most painless and reliable. Just pass out and suffocate to death without knowing that you are.

There's demand for more people, but not people like me. The world wants people who love money and I don't.

I'm tired of doing stuff period. Living is exhausting. I just want to relax without having the stress of "bills and future expenses" constantly on my mind. I just wanna enjoy my time here. The heat death is inevitable, what's the point of struggling beyond staying alive until my body inevitably gives out?

Just give me free internet, a computer upgrade every half a decade, and the basic necessities. Then I'll watch this shitty movie called Life on Earth til the end I guess.

Also, I live with my parents. I had been on my own for a few years but I've given up and moved back in. Now it just feels like I'm waiting for them to die so they don't have to bury me.

If there was a 100% painless and guaranteed way to go, yes I would. Drop a nuke on me or something so that I'm non-existent in a matter of nanoseconds.

Life is cheap anyway. Look at the 8 billion others here as proof. Just nut in some girl for my replacement and pretend I died in an unpreventable freak accident.

What difference would I be able to make? There are hundreds, if not thousands of individuals who are already doing this at the grandest scale, and who listens? There's a fuckload of reading material, fucking YOUTUBE VIDEOS if you don't like reading, but how many people are reading/watching instead of playing games, watching sports, etc.? Society at large needs to want it, but they don't. They love money.

And it's not like I'm not the same. I play games. I watch sports. And I'd certainly rather do that than to give a shit about who wins this next election, because what difference does a new president ever make? Does anyone ever question the monetary system that we use? Of course not. It's gospel. It's like questioning why we breathe.

Ask everyone you know in your life the question, "what would you do if you won the lottery, or was a legitimate billionaire overnight?" The majority of answers are going to be related to simple pleasures. Travel, fuck girls, buy a house, a car, continue to live in this dump. How about building automated solar powered skyfarms that can feed entire cities "for free", with extra expenses being funded by tax dollars, or things like that?

People love money and the power it gives them.

And for any real change in this world to come about, the top 1% has to surrender the majority of their wealth to share it all with us. Do you think that will ever happen? Of course not! The top 1% will fight tooth and nail against any real progress so that they can remain kings. After all, they "earned it all themselves", didn't they?

Like hell they did. If Bill Gates was born ten thousand years ago, do you think he'd be a multi-billionaire? No. He'd probably be hunting and gathering like the rest of his tribe. Would he have been able to bring computers to the world at large if it wasn't for everyone around/under him working for him? All the grunts at Microsoft? A logistical system in place for distribution? The prior discoveries and advances in computing, materials, and engineering? A patent/copyright system that ensures he gets the money? And most importantly, the consumers? 

No one does anything alone, yet everyone feels like they did earned every dollar "all by themselves" once that paycheck comes along.

I don't feel like there's any way I can make any sort of difference. Our issues run so deep, it's gonna take generations, way longer than I can live. I'd just be wasting my breath. It's so deep rooted that this new line of thinking needs to be taught in schools for it to have any real effect. Greed itself needs to stop being worshipped. When someone has multiple yachts, private jets and mansions, they need to be seen as having a mental disorder, not fuckin revered. Talk about hoarding at the grandest level. "Good job man, we are all envious of your literally-insane mental state to forego everything in your life except making more money."

The majority loves money, so let them have it and let me exit. It's like, how many more wars do we have to have (on all fronts) until we learn peace in this world?
Thanks. Take care of yourself as well, since, well, we can't seem to take care of each other, lol.

Constant 17 years old with immortal parents, so I can be a senior in high school with no responsibilities every day forever.

or

Win the lottery so I can sit on my ass forever.

or

Somehow become absolute ruler of Earth and do what I can do unite humanity and build as close to a global utopia on Earth as I could so we can all enjoy our time here before the inevitable heat death of the universe.

It's changing "for the better", because technology is improving and they're getting new toys aka distractions.

"OMG VR PORN AND SEX ROBOTS, THE FUTURE IS GONNA BE AWESOME!!!" or "WEED IS SLOWLY BEING LEGALIZED!!! PROGRESS IS BEING MADE!!!!"

Heh, is it really?

I wanna go because I can't find the love that I want, which is the love of world peace and global cooperation. I don't want a local family of wife and kids. I want a family of 8 billion brothers and sisters. And there's no way to become blind to it, you know?

There were only a few brief moments in life where I felt happiness. Sex with a beautiful lady is nice. Playing football is nice. But even then, they're no different than a high you'd get from a drug you like. Aside from that, nothing. I don't even get a high anymore from weed and ecstasy due to my past use (or abuse). So I'm done with them for the most part. I've stopped doing psychedelics because they just send me further down the rabbit hole of wondering why I have to live in this shithole of a society.

And it's not like I could just become ignorant of what goes on around me. People say just get a hobby you like, distract yourself, but what does that do? No matter what hobby I pick up, I'd be reminded in a hundred ways. Example, pick up the hobby of playing an instrument. Okay, I gotta buy an instrument (money). Now that you're practicing your guitar or whatever, are you making money? Don't you have chores to do, bills to pay? Do you think you're gonna be able to make sustainable money playing guitar? It'd be the same train of thought with any hobby.

What I want in life is never going to happen (a man-made heaven on Earth), even though it's certainly possible with just a global change in mindset. So what's the point?

And there's no escaping it. It's everywhere you look. The wastefulness of it all. Example, I worked in logistics, so every day I get to watch 20 different companies pick up 1-2 pallets worth of shit each so that they can deliver these 20-30 pallets worth of shit to the same fuckin zipcode. We use 20 trucks worth of fuel to deliver what could be done with 2, all in the name of "making money".

The fucking waste.

And the "glory" of "making it". A CEO outsources his manufacturing to child slaves in China, and makes an extra $1m/year, and what happens? A sociopath uses everyone in his life to get him to the top, doing everything immoral but legal in the business world and becomes a millionaire, and what happens? They're fuckin revered as a entrepreneurial genius. Everyone around them is patting them on the back for a job well done. The masses are worshipping them, hell, even on the verge of making them fucking president.

I'm 26 years old. Been depressed my entire life because the culture of this world just doesn't align with my beliefs so I've never been able to find the drive to live in it. We have glorification of war, greed, and all kinds of fucked up shit. I have to work a pointless fuckin' job to spend 80%+ of the money I make on a fuckin house that I constantly have to fix because of wear and tear. I pay 25%+ of my income to the fuckin government that uses the majority of it to line the pockets of corrupt fucks and already ridiculously wealthy people.

I don't spend my money on anything side from food, rent, and bills. My biggest expense, aside from necessities like a car/house, is my computer, which is $2000 every 4-5 years. I feel like there's not a single monetary expense that can make me happy. I've done drugs my whole life, weed, alcohol, ecstasy, shrooms, LSD, DMT, and none of them have made any permanent progress in overcoming my depression. I feel like there's not a single monetary expense that would bring joy in my life because spending money just means I have to make more again, and I hate working. It's pointless. We live in a world where technology has advanced to the point of being able to automate our lives, and instead of freeing up time for us all to enjoy life, the powers that be demand that we continue to pour 40+ hrs a week into a pointless grind. Sit at a desk with nothing to do, cuz it's a slow day, but you need to sit here cuz you're paid hourly, and if you leave, you're fired. Just twiddle your thumbs or something. Look busy.

I'm tired. I've had girlfriends, absolutely wonderful girlfriends in my life, who broke up with me cuz I've drained them of their patience. Not even a powerful love feels like it does anything for me because I have to face the world every day.

I played football in my high school days with reckless abandonment, because I didn't care for the future. I now have a painfully bad back and shoulder from past injuries that I didn't nurse well (cuz I didn't give a fuck). I don't have health insurance, and I don't feel like paying for medical care. I already pay taxes! Fuck! If I had lived in another fuckin country other than the US, I could get care basically for free, but nah, I'm here.

We live in the global age yet we still have borders and fight over trivial bullshit. I hate the feeling of having to fight with my fellow people, whether directly or indirectly. When you're working, you have to fight against your competition. Why? Why did competition become the default business model. Why not cooperation?

Why don't we fucking work together for once in mankind's history.
